name: Max Quality
description: Forces maximum graphical detail in Geometry Dash: UHD textures always, smooth bilinear/trilinear/anisotropic filtering, and a particle-count multiplier with cap removal.

enabled.name: Enable Max Quality
enabled.description: Master toggle. When off, the mod is a complete no-op and the game renders exactly like vanilla.

force-uhd.name: Force UHD Textures
force-uhd.description: Always select the -uhd asset variants regardless of screen resolution. Highest fidelity, slightly higher VRAM use.

texture-filter.name: Texture Filtering
texture-filter.description: nearest = sharp pixels (vanilla-ish). bilinear = smoothed when scaled. trilinear = bilinear + mipmap blending (smoothest, recommended).

anisotropic.name: Anisotropic Filtering
anisotropic.description: Anisotropic level for slanted/scaled sprites. 1 = off, 16 = maximum quality. Combined with trilinear filtering this gives a strong anti-aliasing effect on sprite edges. Ignored if your GPU does not support GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic.

particle-multiplier.name: Particle Multiplier
particle-multiplier.description: Multiplies every emitter's totalParticles. 1.0 = vanilla, 2.0 = twice as many, 4.0 = very dense (perf cost). 0.5 = halved (lower-end GPUs).

uncap-particles.name: Remove Particle Cap
uncap-particles.description: Removes Geometry Dash's internal hard cap on simultaneously-alive particles so dense effects (rocket trails, explosions) can fully render.

verbose-log.name: Verbose Log
verbose-log.description: Spams the Geode console with per-texture / per-emitter info. Debug only — leave off for normal play.
